ayahs.1: Yaqeenan imaan walon ne falah haasil kar li.
ayahs.2: Jo apni namaz mein khushoo karte hain.
ayahs.3: Jo laghviyat se munh mod lete hain.
ayahs.4: Jo zakaat ada karne wale hain.
ayahs.5: Jo apni sharmgaahon ki hifaazat karne wale hain.
ayahs.6: Bajuz apni biwiyon aur milkiyat ki laundiyon ke yaqeenan yeh malamatiyon mein se nahin hain.
ayahs.7: Jo us ke siwa kuchh aur chaahein wohi hadd se tajawuz kar jaane wale hain.
ayahs.8: Jo apni amaanaton aur waade ki hifaazat karne wale hain.
ayahs.9: Jo apni namazon ki nigehbaani karte hain.
ayahs.11: Jo firdaus ke waaris honge jahan woh hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.12: Yaqeenan hum ne insan ko mitti ke johar se paida kiya.
ayahs.13: Phir use nutfa bana kar mahfooz jagah mein qaraar de diya.
ayahs.14: Phir nutfa ko hum ne jama hua khoon bana diya, phir is khoon ke lothde ko gosht ka tukda kar diya. Phir gosht ke tukde ko haddiyan bana din, phir haddiyon ko hum ne gosht pehna diya, phir doosri banaawat mein is ko paida kar diya. Barkaton wala hai woh Allah jo sab se behtareen paida karne wala hai.
ayahs.15: Is ke baad phir tum sab yaqeenan mar jaane wale ho.
ayahs.16: Phir qayamat ke din bila-shubha tum sab uthaaye jaao ge.
ayahs.17: Hum ne tumhare oopar saat aasman banaaye hain aur hum makhlooqaat se ghaafil nahin hain.
ayahs.18: Hum ek saheeh andaaz se aasman se paani barsaate hain, phir use zameen mein thehra dete hain, aur hum is ke le jaane par yaqeenan qaadir hain.
ayahs.19: Isi paani ke zariye se hum tumhare liye khajooron aur angooron ke baaghaat paida kar dete hain, ke tumhare liye in mein bahut se mewe hote hain in hi mein se tum khaate bhi ho.
ayahs.20: Aur woh darakht jo Toor-e-Sina pahaad se nikalta hai jo tel nikaalta hai aur khaane wale ke liye saalan hai.
ayahs.21: Tumhare liye chaupaayon mein bhi badi bhaari ibrat hai. Un ke peton mein se hum tumhein doodh pilaate hain aur bhi bahut se nafa tumhare liye in mein hain in mein se baaz baaz ko tum khaate bhi ho.
ayahs.22: Aur un par aur kashtiyon par tum sawaar karaaye jaate ho.
ayahs.23: Yaqeenan hum ne Nooh (alaihis salaam) ko us ki qaum ki taraf Rasool bana kar bheja, us ne kaha ke aye meri qaum ke logo! Allah ki ibaadat karo aur us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin, kya tum (us se) nahin darte.
ayahs.24: Us ki qaum ke kaafir sardaron ne saaf keh diya ke yeh to tum jaisa hi insan hai, yeh tum par fazeelat aur badaai haasil karna chaahta hai. Agar Allah hi ko manzoor hota to kisi farishte ko utaarta, hum ne to use apne agle baap dadon ke zamaane mein suna hi nahin.
ayahs.25: Yaqeenan is shakhs ko junoon hai, pas tum use ek waqt-e-muqarrar tak dheel do.
ayahs.26: Nooh (alaihis salaam) ne dua ki aye mere Rabb! Un ke jhutlaane par tu meri madad kar.
ayahs.27: To hum ne un ki taraf wahi bheji ke tu hamari aankhon ke saamne hamari wahi ke mutaabiq ek kashti bana. Jab hamara hukm aa jaaye aur tanoor ubal pade to, tu har qism ka ek ek joda us mein rakh le aur apne ahl ko bhi, magar un mein se jin ki baabat hamari baat pehle guzar chuki hai. Khabardaar jin logon ne zulm kiya hai un ke baare mein mujh se kuchh kalaam na karna woh to sab duboye jaayenge.
ayahs.28: Jab tu aur tere saathi kashti par ba-itminaan baith jaao to kehna ke sab tareef Allah ke liye hi hai jis ne hamein zaalim logon se najaat ata farmaayi.
ayahs.29: Aur kehna ke aye mere Rabb! Mujhe ba-barkat utaarna utaar aur tu hi behtar hai utaarne walon mein.
ayahs.30: Yaqeenan is mein badi badi nishaaniyan hain aur hum beshak aazmaaish karne wale hain.
ayahs.31: Un ke baad hum ne aur bhi ummat paida ki.
ayahs.32: Phir un mein khud un mein se (hi) Rasool bhi bheja ke tum sab Allah ki ibaadat karo us ke siwa tumhara koi mabood nahin, tum kyun nahin darte?
ayahs.33: Aur sardaraan-e-qaum ne jawab diya, jo kufr karte the aur aakhirat ki mulaaqaat ko jhutlaate the aur hum ne unhein dunyawi zindagi mein khushhaal kar rakha tha, ke yeh to tum jaisa hi insan hai, tumhari hi khuraak yeh bhi khaata hai aur tumhare peene ka paani hi yeh peeta hai.
ayahs.34: Agar tum ne apne jaise hi insan ki taabedaari kar li hai to beshak tum sakht khasaare wale ho.
ayahs.35: Kya yeh tumhein is baat ka wada karta hai ke jab tum mar kar sirf khaak aur haddi reh jaao ge to tum phir zinda kiye jaao ge.
ayahs.36: Nahin nahin door aur bahut door hai woh jis ka tum wada diye jaate ho.
ayahs.37: (Zindagi) to sirf dunya ki zindagi hai hum marte jeete rehte hain aur yeh nahin ke hum phir uthaaye jaayenge.
ayahs.38: Yeh to bas aisa shakhs hai jis ne Allah par jhoot (bohtan) baandh liya hai, hum to is par imaan laane wale nahin hain.
ayahs.39: Nabi ne dua ki ke Parwardigar! Un ke jhutlaane par tu meri madad kar.
ayahs.40: Jawab mila ke yeh to bahut hi jald apne kiye par pachhtaane lagenge.
ayahs.41: Bil-aakhir adl ke taqaaze ke mutaabiq cheekh ne pakad liya aur hum ne unhein kooda-karkat kar daala, pas zaalimon ke liye doori ho.
ayahs.42: Un ke baad hum ne aur bhi bahut si ummaten paida kin.
ayahs.43: Na to koi ummat apne waqt-e-muqarrara se aage badhi aur na peechhe rahi.
ayahs.44: Phir hum ne lagataar Rasool bheje, jab jab is ummat ke paas us ka Rasool aaya us ne jhutlaaya, pas hum ne ek doosre ke peechhe laga diya aur unhein afsaana bana diya. Un logon ko doori hai jo imaan qubool nahin karte.
ayahs.45: Phir hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko aur un ke bhai Haaroon (alaihis salaam) ko apni aayaton aur khuli daleel ke saath bheja.
ayahs.46: Firaun aur us ke lashkaron ki taraf, pas unhon ne takabbur kiya aur the hi woh sarkash log.
ayahs.47: Kehne lage ke kya hum apne jaise do shakhs par imaan laayen? Halaanke khud un ki qaum (bhi) hamare matahat hai.
ayahs.48: Pas unhon ne un donon ko jhutlaaya aakhir woh bhi halaak-shuda logon mein mil gaye.
ayahs.49: Hum ne to Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko kitaab (bhi) di ke log raah-e-raast par aa jaayen.
ayahs.50: Hum ne Ibn-e-Maryam aur us ki waalida ko ek nishani banaaya aur un donon ko buland saaf qaraar wali aur jaari paani wali jagah mein panaah di.
ayahs.51: Aye Paighambaro! Halaal cheezen khaao aur nek amal karo tum jo kuchh kar rahe ho is se main ba-khoobi waaqif hoon.
ayahs.52: Yaqeenan tumhara yeh deen ek hi deen hai aur main hi tum sab ka Rabb hoon, pas tum mujh se darte raho.
ayahs.53: Phir unhon ne khud (hi) apne amr (deen) ke aapas mein tukde tukde kar liye, har giroh jo kuchh us ke paas hai isi par itra raha hai.
ayahs.54: Pas aap (bhi) unhein un ki ghaflat mein hi kuchh muddat pada rehne den.
ayahs.55: Kya yeh (yun) samajh baithe hain? Ke hum jo bhi un ke maal-o-aulaad badha rahe hain.
ayahs.56: Woh un ke liye bhalaaiyon mein jaldi kar rahe hain (nahin nahin) balke yeh samajhte hi nahin.
ayahs.57: Yaqeenan jo log apne Rabb ki haibat se darte hain.
ayahs.58: Aur jo apne Rabb ki aayaton par imaan rakhte hain.
ayahs.59: Aur jo apne Rabb ke saath kisi ko shareek nahin karte.
ayahs.60: Aur jo log dete hain jo kuchh dete hain aur un ke dil kapkapaate hain ke woh apne Rabb ki taraf lautne wale hain.
ayahs.61: Yehi hain jo jaldi jaldi bhalaaiyan haasil kar rahe hain aur yehi hain jo un ki taraf daud jaane wale hain.
ayahs.62: Hum kisi nafs ko us ki taaqat se ziyaada takleef nahin dete, aur hamare paas aisi kitaab hai jo haq ke saath bolti hai, un ke oopar kuchh zulm na kiya jaayega.
ayahs.63: Balke un ke dil is taraf se ghaflat mein hain aur un ke liye is ke siwa bhi bahut se aamaal hain jinhein woh karne wale hain.
ayahs.64: Yahan tak ke jab hum ne un ke aasooda-haal logon ko azaab mein pakad liya to woh bilbilaane lage.
ayahs.65: Aaj mat bilbilaao yaqeenan tum hamare muqaable par madad na kiye jaao ge.
ayahs.66: Meri aayaten to tumhare saamne padhi jaati thin phir bhi tum apni ediyon ke bal ulte bhaagte the.
ayahs.67: Akadte, ainthte, afsaana-goi karte use chhod dete the.
ayahs.68: Kya unhon ne is baat mein ghaur-o-fikr hi nahin kiya? Balke un ke paas woh aaya jo un ke agle baap dadon ke paas nahin aaya tha?
ayahs.69: Ya unhon ne apne Paighambar ko pehchaana nahin ke us ke munkir ho rahe hain?
ayahs.70: Ya yeh kehte hain ke use junoon hai? Balke woh to un ke paas haq laaya hai. Haan un mein aksar haq se chidhne wale hain.
ayahs.71: Agar haq hi un ki khwahishon ka pairau ho jaaye to zameen-o-aasman aur un ke darmiyaan ki har cheez darham-barham ho jaaye. Haq to yeh hai ke hum ne unhein un ki naseehat pahuncha di hai lekin woh apni naseehat se munh modne wale hain.
ayahs.72: Kya aap un se koi ujrat chaahtay hain? Yaad rakhiye ke aap ke Rabb ki ujrat bahut hi behtar hai aur woh sab se behtar rozi-rasaan hai.
ayahs.73: Yaqeenan aap to unhein raah-e-raast ki taraf bula rahe hain.
ayahs.74: Beshak jo log aakhirat par yaqeen nahin rakhte woh seedhe raaste se mud jaane wale hain.
ayahs.75: Aur agar hum un par rahm farmaayen aur un ki takleefen door kar den to yeh to apni apni sarkashi mein jam kar aur behakne lagen.
ayahs.76: Aur hum ne unhein azaab mein bhi pakda taaham yeh log na to apne Parwardigar ke saamne jhuke aur na hi aajizi ikhtiyaar ki.
ayahs.77: Yahan tak ke jab hum ne un par sakht azaab ka darwaaza khol diya to isi waqt foran mayoos ho gaye.
ayahs.78: Woh Allah hai jis ne tumhare liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil paida kiye, magar tum bahut (hi) kam shukr karte ho.
ayahs.79: Aur wahi hai jis ne tumhein paida kar ke zameen mein phaila diya aur isi ki taraf tum jama kiye jaao ge.
ayahs.80: Aur yeh wahi hai jo jilaata aur maarta hai aur raat din ke radd-o-badal ka mukhtaar bhi wahi hai. Kya tum ko samajh-boojh nahin?
ayahs.81: Balke in logon ne bhi waisi hi baat kahi jo agle kehte chale aaye.
ayahs.82: Ke kya jab hum mar kar mitti aur haddi ho jaayenge kya phir bhi hum zaroor uthaaye jaayenge?
ayahs.83: Hum se aur hamare baap dadon se pehle hi yeh wada hota chala aaya hai kuchh nahin yeh to sirf agle logon ke afsaane hain.
ayahs.84: Poochhiye to sahi ke zameen aur is ki kul cheezen kis ki hain? Batlaao agar jaante ho?
ayahs.85: Foran jawab denge ke Allah ki, keh dijiye ke phir tum naseehat kyun nahin haasil karte.
ayahs.86: Daryaaft kijiye ke saaton aasman ka aur bahut ba-azmat arsh ka Rabb kaun hai?
ayahs.87: Woh log jawab denge ke Allah hi hai. Keh dijiye ke phir tum kyun nahin darte?
ayahs.88: Poochhiye ke tamaam cheezon ka ikhtiyaar kis ke haath mein hai? Jo panaah deta hai aur jis ke muqaable mein koi panaah nahin diya jaata, agar tum jaante ho to batla do?
ayahs.89: Yehi jawab denge ke Allah hi hai, keh dijiye phir tum kidhar se jaadu kar diye jaate ho?
ayahs.90: Haq yeh hai ke hum ne unhein haq pahuncha diya hai aur yeh beshak jhoote hain.
ayahs.91: Na to Allah ne kisi ko beta banaaya aur na us ke saath aur koi mabood hai, warna har mabood apni makhlooq ko liye liye phirta aur har ek doosre par chadh daudta. Jo awsaaf yeh batlaate hain un se Allah paak (aur be-niyaaz) hai.
ayahs.92: Woh ghaib haazir ka jaanne wala hai aur jo shirk yeh karte hain is se baala-tar hai.
ayahs.93: Aap dua karen ke aye mere Parwardigar! Agar tu mujhe woh dikhaaye jis ka wada unhein diya ja raha hai.
ayahs.94: To aye Rabb! Tu mujhe in zaalimon ke giroh mein na karna.
ayahs.95: Hum jo kuchh waade unhein de rahe hain sab aap ko dikha dene par yaqeenan qaadir hain.
ayahs.96: Buraai ko is tareeqe se door karen jo sarasar bhalaai wala ho, jo kuchh yeh bayan karte hain hum ba-khoobi waaqif hain.
ayahs.97: Aur dua karen ke aye mere Parwardigar! Main shaytaanon ke waswason se teri panaah chaahta hoon.
ayahs.98: Aur aye Rabb! Main teri panaah chaahta hoon ke woh mere paas aa jaayen.
ayahs.99: Yahan tak ke jab un mein kisi ko maut aane lagti hai to kehta hai aye mere Parwardigar! Mujhe waapas lauta de.
ayahs.100: Ke apni chhodi hui dunya mein ja kar nek aamaal kar loon, hargiz aisa nahin hoga, yeh to sirf ek qaul hai jis ka yeh qaail hai, un ke pas-e-pusht to ek hijaab hai, un ke dobaara jee uthne ke din tak.
ayahs.101: Pas jab ke soor phoonk diya jaayega is din na to aapas ke rishtedaar hi rahenge, na aapas ki poochh-gachh.
ayahs.102: Jin ki taraazu ka palla bhaari ho gaya woh to najaat wale ho gaye.
ayahs.103: Aur jin ke taraazu ka palla halka ho gaya yeh hain woh jinhon ne apna nuqsaan aap kar liya jo hamesha ke liye jahannam-waasil hue.
ayahs.104: Un ke chehron ko aag jhulasti rahegi aur woh wahan bad-shakal bane hue honge.
ayahs.105: Kya meri aayaten tumhare saamne tilaawat nahin ki jaati thin? Phir bhi tum unhein jhutlaate the.
ayahs.106: Kahenge ke aye Parwardigar! Hamari badbakhti hum par ghaalib aa gayi (waaqai) hum the hi gumraah.
ayahs.107: Aye hamare Parwardigar! Hamein yahan se najaat de agar ab bhi hum aisa hi karen to beshak hum zaalim hain.
ayahs.108: Allah Taala farmaayega phitkaare hue yahin pade raho aur mujh se kalaam na karo.
ayahs.109: Mere bandon ki ek jamaat thi jo baraabar yehi kehti rahi ke aye hamare Parwardigar! Hum imaan la chuke hain to hamein bakhsh aur hum par rahm farma tu sab mehrbaanon se ziyaada mehrbaan hai.
ayahs.110: (Lekin) tum unhein mazaaq mein hi udaate rahe yahan tak ke (is mashghale ne) tum ko meri yaad (bhi) bhula di aur tum un se mazaaq hi karte rahe.
ayahs.111: Main ne aaj unhein un ke is sabr ka badla de diya hai ke woh khaatir-khwaah apni muraad ko pahunch chuke hain.
ayahs.112: Allah Taala daryaaft farmaayega ke tum zameen mein baitibaar-e-barson ki ginti ke kis qadr rahe?
ayahs.113: Woh kahenge ek din ya ek din se bhi kam, ginti ginne walon se bhi poochh lijiye.
ayahs.114: Allah Taala farmaayega fil-waqe tum wahan bahut hi kam rahe ho aye kaash! Tum use pehle hi se jaan lete?
ayahs.115: Kya tum yeh gumaan kiye hue ho ke hum ne tumhein yun hi bekaar paida kiya hai aur yeh ke tum hamari taraf lautaaye hi na jaao ge.
ayahs.116: Allah Taala sachcha baadshaah hai woh badi bulandi wala hai. Us ke siwa koi mabood nahin, wahi buzurg arsh ka maalik hai.
ayahs.117: Jo shakhs Allah ke saath kisi doosre mabood ko pukaare jis ki koi daleel us ke paas nahin, pas us ka hisaab to us ke Rabb ke oopar hi hai. Beshak kaafir log najaat se mehroom hain.
ayahs.118: Aur kaho ke aye mere Rabb! Tu bakhsh aur rahm kar aur tu sab mehrbaanon se behtar mehrbaani karne wala hai.
